companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Gas processing, gathering and NGL extraction
companyFieldUpdates.description: Pembina Gas Infrastructure Inc. is a Western Canadian gas-processing and midstream platform serving producers in the Montney and Duvernay regions. Its fee-based infrastructure footprint extends from central Alberta to northeast British Columbia and includes 23 gas-processing facilities, approximately 3,900 kilometres of pipelines, more than 5 Bcf/d of processing capacity and approximately 330,000 barrels per day of NGL extraction capacity. Pembina owns 60% and operates the platform; Apollo-managed funds own the remaining 40% following their 2026 acquisition from KKR-managed infrastructure funds.

set.event: The PGI joint venture closed with Pembina owning 60% and KKR-managed infrastructure funds owning 40%.
Pembina and KKR announced the combination of their Western Canadian natural-gas processing assets into PGI at a 60% / 40% ownership split.
Pembina closed the PGI combination and became the 60% owner and operator; KKR-managed infrastructure funds held 40%.
Apollo-managed funds completed the acquisition of KKR's 40% interest; the exact legal closing day was not publicly disclosed.
